text: The greenhouse project in Fairbank Memorial Park will be operated and maintained by the York Fairbank Centre for Seniors, and will become a year-round gardening destination for the entire community. In order to ensure year-round operations a winterized water line is required to service the greenhouse, and is to be installed by Parks, Forestry and Recreation. Authority is being sought to transfer Section 42 Alternate Rate Cash-in-lieu funds for this purpose. This Motion is urgent to allow design and construction to continue on schedule.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1.
